documents_and_code_inspected: PlantUML FontStack.java, UFontImpl.java, FileFormat.java, and StringBounderRaw.java at the pinned Java revision

java_model_assessment.font_selection: For a single requested family, FontStack retains the primary Times New Roman AWT Font and UFontImpl applies the requested face and integer size. Java2D may still substitute physical glyphs internally for scalars absent from that face.
java_model_assessment.measurement: FileFormat.getJavaDimension asks FontMetrics.getStringBounds for the complete string at the requested size. It does not measure at 2048 points and scale the result.
java_model_assessment.corrected_case: For U+0518 CYRILLIC CAPITAL LETTER YAE, the exact 2048-point 16.16 advance scales and accumulates like AWT across the tested sizes and all four binary faces.
java_model_assessment.disproved_assumption: An exact source advance at 2048 points is not necessarily a size-independent per-em advance for AWT fallback glyphs. U+231A WATCH is exactly scalar-additive, yet its requested-size advance is 15px at size 11, 22px at size 17, and 23px at size 19, while the table model yields 11px, 17px, and 19px.

generator_reproducibility.defect: The generator proves exact 16.16 representation only at its 2048-point extraction size. It does not prove that AWT's requested-size fallback advance is linear in that value.

exhaustive_probe.scope: Every assigned non-surrogate scalar from U+0080 upward, initially across plain Times New Roman at sizes 1, 2, 3, and 7 before stopping after a decisive counterexample.
exhaustive_probe.size_1: 1,910 scalar advances differed; maximum observed error 0.000026702880859px at U+0C01.
exhaustive_probe.size_2: 3,201 scalar advances differed; maximum observed error 1px at U+231A.
exhaustive_probe.size_3: 4,830 scalar advances differed; maximum observed error 1px at U+231A.
exhaustive_probe.size_7: 4,663 scalar advances differed; maximum observed error 2px at U+231A.
exhaustive_probe.termination: The broad scan was interrupted after size 7 because a valid, exactly additive, high-magnitude counterexample had already rejected the invariant.

fractional_control.assessment: The corrective fixed-point and ordered-f32 model repairs the prior rejection.

rejecting_counterexample.additivity: Exact at every tested size and face: Java whole-string width equals 32 times the Java scalar width.
rejecting_counterexample.face_results: Plain, bold, italic, and bold-italic produce the same fallback-width discrepancy at sizes 7, 11, 17, and 19.
rejecting_counterexample.scope_assessment: Rejecting and in scope. A single WATCH scalar has no contextual shaping, ligature, grapheme cluster, emoji sequence, or multi-family font stack, and repetition remains exactly additive.

declared_residue_probe.assessment: The mixed fallback run is not scalar-additive and is classified outside this mechanism's stated boundary. It is preserved but is not needed for rejection.

verdict_reason: The corrective 16.16 model fixes fractional source advances but still assumes every assigned scalar's requested-size AWT advance is a linear scale of its 2048-point advance. Fresh valid U+231A WATCH perturbations disprove that assumption across sizes and all four faces while remaining exactly scalar-additive. T14 requires an in-scope held-out counterexample to reject the mechanism.
